facts.text: Jacob is in a village with Shiva and Kali.
Jacob explains an offering to the villagers.
The villagers hoped Lorelei would do something.
A man and a woman look at each other in surprise at the name Lorelei.
The man introduces himself as Shiva.
The woman introduces herself as Kali.
Shiva and Kali say they are hunting a fugitive when asked what brings them to the village.
Jacob wakes up at night to get some water.
Jacob hears voices coming from Jacob's late father's old room.
Shiva and Kali are wide awake in Jacob's late father's old room.
Shiva and Kali have found an old tablet passed down in Jacob's family.
The old tablet is a picture of two guardian spirits.
Shiva and Kali chuckle about how they used to dress.
The next day, Jacob and the others eat a meager breakfast.
Kali notices Jacob collecting more food that is left.
Jacob sighs when Kali asks what he is doing.
Jacob wants to try another large offering that day.
Jacob says the last offering did not please Lorelei.
Jacob says the last offering did not draw Eri and Racita out of hiding.
Jacob believes the next offering might draw Eri and Racita out of hiding.
Shiva and Kali exchange a horrified look when Jacob mentions Eri and Racita.
Shiva asks who Jacob thinks Eri and Racita are.
Jacob answers Shiva's question while confused.
Shiva and Kali look sad and worried but do not say another word.
Shiva helps Jacob carry items for the offering.
Shiva asks Jacob questions about Lorelei.
Shiva asks how long the village has worshipped Lorelei.
Jacob tells Shiva about a meteor hundreds of years ago.
Jacob tells Shiva about miracles.
Jacob tells Shiva about Jacob's encounter on the mountain.
Jacob says Lorelei warned Jacob that Eri and Racita would continue to do harm to the village unless stopped.
Shiva looks sad and angry as Jacob talks.
Shiva warns Jacob to be careful.

events.text: Jacob wakes up at night to get water and hears voices from his late father's old room where Shiva and Kali are wide awake
The next day, Jacob and the others eat a meager breakfast and Jacob plans another large offering
Jacob and Shiva carry items for the offering and Jacob tells Shiva about the meteor, miracles, and Lorelei's warning
